title: Step $$1$$
text: Step $$1$$ applies the distributive property $$a\left(b+c\right)=ab+ac$$. This is carried out correctly. $$2\left(x+3\right)=2x+6$$

title: Step $$2$$
text: Step $$2$$ combines the constant terms correctly.

title: Step $$3$$
text: Step $$3$$ incorrectly applies the rule $$\frac{a+b}{c}=\frac{a}{c}+\frac{b}{c}$$. It should be $$\frac{2x+10}{2}=\frac{2x}{2}+\frac{10}{2}$$

title: Step $$4$$
text: Step $$4$$ correctly cancels the nonzero common factor in numerator and denominator $$\frac{ab}{ac}=\frac{b}{c}$$ and the fact that $$\frac{a}{1}=a$$. This is carried out in the step $$\frac{2x}{2}=\frac{x}{1}=x$$.
